bio.name: Reuben Chatterjee
paragraphs: I build end-to-end ML systems and scalable data pipelines that turn complex data into clear business impact.

Currently on the AI/ML team at Applied Materials, architecting solutions for Computer Vision problems, training custom object detection models (RT-DETR, YOLO etc.), and designing OCR pipelines with vision-language models (GLM, Qwen VL, Paddle, Gemini etc.).
Previously at Alcamo Marketing, where I cut infrastructure costs by 60%. I also built a churn model that identified $2.1M in at-risk revenue.
Master's in Data Science from UC San Diego.

featured.title: Multi-Model OCR Pipeline for Industrial Labels
featured.description: Production-grade OCR system combining vision-language models (Claude Sonnet 4.5, Qwen VL, PaddleOCR) with a custom RT-DETR detector — 85.7% precision across 500+ industrial labels, 3–5× faster inference via GPU optimization on Databricks.

image.alt: Multi-Model OCR Pipeline for Industrial Labels project image

projects.title: Technician Certification Route Recommender
projects.description: Databricks recommender that scores 433K candidate operations to rank the top 5 certification routes for ~2,000 technicians. Built as a weekly scheduled job that writes ~7,000 rows to SQL Server in under 5 minutes, with CI/CD through Jenkins and Databricks Asset Bundles.

image.alt: Technician Certification Route Recommender project image

projects.title: Afterpay Retention Prediction
projects.description: Gradient boosting churn model — 89% accuracy, 0.92 ROC-AUC — identifying $2.1M in at-risk revenue across 4 risk tiers.

projects.title: Gender & Group Dynamics Study
projects.description: Statistical analysis of 500+ students examining gender composition effects on team dynamics using ANOVA and NLP.

image.alt: Gender & Group Dynamics Study project image

projects.title: Credit Card Fraud Detection
projects.description: Ensemble fraud model trained on 97K+ transactions combining LightGBM, XGBoost, and a CNN classifier.

image.alt: Credit Card Fraud Detection project image

projects.title: Student Accommodation Service
projects.description: Roommate-matching mobile app pairing students via K-Means clustering on the OCEAN personality model.

experience.role: Data Scientist · AI/ML, Data Insights & Apps
bullets: Architected multi-model OCR pipeline using vision-language models achieving 85.7% precision on 500+ industrial labels.
Trained RT-DETR object detection achieving 97.8% precision on printed labels.
Improved inference efficiency 3–5× through GPU optimization and NVMe caching on Databricks.
Built 15 production ETL pipelines processing 50GB+ daily data using SQL, Fivetran, Snowflake, Looker.
Reduced operational costs 60% through infrastructure migration from Adverity to Snowflake.
Developed XGBoost churn prediction model identifying $2.1M in at-risk revenue.
Lead TA for COGS 108, managing a team of 16 TAs across 800+ students (Jan — Jun 2025).
Research Lead at Ellis Lab — gender disparities in data science education (Sep 2024 — Jun 2025).
Data Science Intern at Datamatics Global Services, 92% prediction accuracy on demand forecasting (Jul — Sep 2024).
Coursework: Statistical Models, Causal Inference, Scalable Systems, Deep Learning.
Created AR/VR-ready 3D assets using Blender for an EdTech startup.
Helped shape the 3D animation team and visual language.
Foundation in machine learning, statistical analysis, and scalable systems.
Found my path in data science in 2020 — Python, SQL, DBMS.
